footer_tag: Building AI data centre infrastructure for East Malaysia.
home_title: WCH Solutions | AI data centre infrastructure in Sarawak
home_desc: WCH Solutions Sdn Bhd develops AI data centre infrastructure in Sarawak: powered space, cooling, connectivity and operations, backed by a 10 MW power contract.
home_lead: WCH Solutions is building a phased AI data centre on Sarawak hydropower: 10 MW contracted, 2 MW in the first phase.
home_why_title: An energy foundation for digital infrastructure
home_why_1_b: Hydropower supplies most of Sarawak's generation mix, with 5.9 GW of available capacity reported in June 2025.
home_why_2_b: Sarawak Energy targets 10 GW of installed capacity by 2030 and 15 GW by 2035.
home_why_3_b: The IEA projects global data-centre electricity use to almost double, from 485 TWh in 2025 to 950 TWh in 2030.
home_build_lead: A data centre is a home for computers. Customers bring their servers. WCH provides the power, cooling, connectivity, security and people that keep them running.
home_team_lead: Business, technology and operations leadership, supported by honorary advisers with Sarawak experience.
home_cta_body: Government agencies, contractors and partners can request a briefing on the site, power arrangements and delivery plan.
about_title: About WCH Solutions | Company and leadership
about_desc: WCH Solutions Sdn Bhd is a Sarawak-focused developer of AI data centre infrastructure. Meet the leadership team and honorary advisers.
about_lead: WCH Solutions Sdn Bhd develops the infrastructure that computers need: reliable power, suitable space and supporting systems.
about_profile_1: WCH plans, builds and operates data centre facilities for AI and high-performance computing. Our first planned facility is in Sarawak.
about_profile_2: We build on strengths Sarawak already has: land, renewable power and industrial operating experience. We put them to work for a new kind of infrastructure.
about_mission_1_b: Start with a 2 MW first phase and expand within a 10 MW power contract as customers commit.
about_mission_2_b: Firm power with backup, independent fibre routes, suitable cooling and a trained team on site around the clock.
about_mission_3_b: Engage Sarawak contractors, suppliers and landowners in construction, electrical work and maintenance.
about_team_lead: Governance and leadership of WCH Solutions Sdn Bhd.
bio_andy: Sarawak business experience and commercial perspective.
project_title: Sarawak AI Data Centre Project | WCH Solutions
project_desc: WCH's phased AI data centre project in Sarawak: 10 MW power contract, 10-year term, 2 MW first phase.
project_h1: A phased AI data centre in Sarawak
project_lead: WCH has a 10 MW power contract with a 10-year term. The first phase plans a 2 MW initial power allocation.
project_phase_body: Phase 1 brings 2 MW online. Later phases expand capacity within the 10 MW contract as customer demand is confirmed.
phase_svg_title: Diagram: Phase 1 uses 2 MW of the 10 MW power contract; future phases use the remaining 8 MW.
project_power_lead: Hydropower supplies most of Sarawak's generation mix. Each site still needs its own grid connection.
project_req_lead: Customers pay for a service they can depend on. The WCH design addresses four requirements.
req_power_b: A firm supply and working backup systems.
req_net_b: Fast connections with independent fibre routes.
req_cool_b: A safe location and a cooling design suited to high-density AI equipment.
req_people_b: A trained team that operates the facility around the clock.
market_1: The IEA projects global data-centre electricity use to rise from 485 TWh in 2025 to 950 TWh in 2030.
market_2: Microsoft launched its first Malaysian cloud region, Malaysia West, in May 2025.
services_desc: Powered space, facility development, equipment hosting and operating support for AI and high-performance computing in Sarawak.
services_lead: WCH helps customers run their computing equipment in a reliable, well-operated facility.
svc_space_b: Suitable premises with the electrical capacity that AI and high-performance computing equipment needs.
svc_dev_b: Design and construction of cooling, connectivity, power distribution and security systems.
svc_host_b: Colocation space and support for customers' own servers, with power and cooling sized to their load.
svc_ops_b: Monitoring, maintenance and day-to-day facility care by an on-site team.
services_how_2: WCH supplies power, cooling, connectivity and security.
services_how_3: WCH operates and maintains the facility around the clock.
cred_desc: Company registration, licences and agreements of WCH Solutions Sdn Bhd.
cred_lead: Documents that confirm WCH's company status and project arrangements.
cred_request: Company registration documents, licences and project agreements are available to government agencies and qualified partners on request.
work_title: Work with WCH | Contractors and suppliers
work_desc: Sarawak contractors and suppliers can register interest in construction, electrical, maintenance and site supply work on WCH's data centre project.
work_lead: WCH plans to work with local firms. Existing skills in construction, power and maintenance transfer directly to data centre work.
work_1_b: Site preparation, buildings and supporting structures.
work_2_b: Substation interface, power distribution and backup systems.
work_3_b: Ongoing maintenance, cooling services and facility care.
work_4_b: Sites or buildings that meet power, access and safety needs.
work_how_body: Send your company profile, your relevant experience and your registration details. WCH will contact suitable firms as work packages are defined.
contact_desc: Contact WCH Solutions Sdn Bhd for project briefings, partnership and contractor enquiries.
contact_lead: Government agencies, contractors and partners: tell us who you are and what you need. We reply by email.

gov_desc: How WCH Solutions is governed, and how its Sarawak data centre project approaches energy, growth and local benefit.
gov_lead: How WCH is run, and how the project uses Sarawak's resources responsibly.
gov_g_1_b: An Executive Chairman, Chief Executive, Chief Operating, Chief Financial and Chief Technology Officer each hold defined responsibility for strategy, business, operations, finance and technology.
gov_g_2_b: Compliance and operating controls are held by the Chief Operating Officer. Financial controls are held by the Chief Financial Officer.
gov_g_3_b: Project figures are labelled as management-provided. Market figures are cited with source and date.
gov_g_4_b: A Board of Directors, led by the Executive Chairman, provides strategic direction and local relationships.
gov_s_lead: Data centres use a lot of electricity. Where that electricity comes from, and how carefully capacity grows, matters.
gov_s_1_b: Hydropower supplies most of Sarawak's generation mix.
gov_s_2_b: A phased build adds capacity as customers commit, so infrastructure is not built to sit idle.
gov_s_3_b: Cooling is designed for high-density AI equipment in a tropical climate. Efficiency targets are set during detailed design.
gov_s_4_b: Work for Sarawak contractors and suppliers, and computing capacity that local industries can use.

home_land_b: Sarawak already runs estates, mills and refineries. The same land, power and operating know-how can host computing facilities.
